nom: Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50

avis.texte: Odorless as it is not water based so has no phenoxyethanol Some of the water based products that are fragrance free contain phenoxyethanol as a preservative and it has a distinct smell and gives me a headache so I needed something for my face that did not contain it. Hope they keep making it!
Great sheet sunscreen that doesn't leave much of a white cast. I think this is more suitable for fair skin tones. Absorption is not too greasy. Lasts well when sweating or being outside

avis.titre: FINALLY A MINERAL SUNSCREEN THAT IS REALLY SHEER
avis.texte: Outstanding, i love it and IT IS SHEER!!! I have tried so many mineral that say sheer and they are not, it leaves a white film thats ugly. I have a lip allergy that makes my lips blister with the uv rays so I was told by my derm doctor to wear mineral sunscreen and couldnt find one that didnt leave the white film until this one!!!!! Its an spf 50 look sheer and so soft on the lips, its worth the money. It protects my lips and they look natural, not weird and white.

I love how convenient this SPF stick is. It glides smoothly onto the skin without feeling greasy ot heavy, and is perfect for quick reapplication throughout the day. It doesn't leave white cast and works well under makeup. The compact size makes it easy to carry in purse or bag

Glides smoothly and gives this sheer glow that i love on my face. Very easy to use and leaves no white cast or residue. Cute and very nice packaging. It doesn't have a strong scent and it doesn't feel sticky.

avis.titre: An easy-to-use sunscreen stick with great protecti
avis.texte: I've been using Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50 and it's super convenient for on-the-go use. The application is smooth and easy, and it provides great coverage and protection. It doesn't pill and only leaves a slight white cast at first, which blends out quickly. It feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin.
Must have in your bag for any season. Reapplying is so easy. Good value for money . Works fine on different skin types . Highly recommended to use .

avis.titre: Mineral, gentle on the skin, travel size
avis.texte: I like that it's mineral and feels gentle on the skin especially around sensitive areas like under the eyes. It goes on pretty smoothly and doesn't feel heavy or greasy. The stick format is really nice for reapplying during the day, especially when you're outside or at the beach here in Florida. It's compact easy to throw in a small bag and no mess. There is a slight white cast if you apply a lot but if you blend it in it's not too noticeable. Overall it feels comfortable on the skin and doesn't irritate me
Great product . Super easy to keep it inside your bag no residue blends amazing great absorption you can used it more that ones . Soft texture good product
Convenient mineral sunscreen, the application is easy, is gentle and dot not affect my dry skin. It layers well under make up. I wear it every day and I use it always in my bag.
I love this product! Goes on smooth and easy to reapply. Easy to carry everywhere. I like it so much better than the sprays. The product is a keeper.

avis.titre: Could've blended better but was still effective
avis.texte: Weight is light and caused no burn and a very nice feel with no stain. Portability and breakouts were rare but I think it could've blended better .

avis.titre: Excellent because even if you suffer, it remains
avis.texte: It's applied after washing your face, and in addition to protecting you from the sun, it also moisturizes. It leaves no residue, its protection is very good, and it protects very well from the sun.
I really like how this sunscreen goes on my kids skin especially the face. You don't need to get your fingers directly just rub on your face and it's done.

This sunscreen stick is a total game-changer! It's super easy to apply and doesn't leave a white cast. I love how lightweight it feels on my skin, and it fits perfectly in my bag for quick touch-ups during the day. It's also fragrance-free, which is great for my sensitive skin. Highly recommend for anyone looking for mess-free sun protection!

I love this product. I am a pretty big sunscreen user and this has made my life a lot easier. I can throw it in my bag when I go hiking, paddle boarding, or running. I have pretty sensitive skin and I've had no issue with this product.

avis.titre: In absolutely no way is this sheer
avis.texte: There is nothing sheet about this stick… it leaves the WORST whitecast. They should not be allowed to advertise this. Stick with any of the other OTC brands and you'll be fine.

I have purchase this twice already. It protects my skin during the summer. I had to repurchase even tho I have tons of face sunscreens. Some ingredients aren't good especially if you are trying to conceive so I had to go back to this one. Zinc oxide is safe for expectant mothers so I had to go back to this one. Only thing tho it's a bit oily and leaves a bit of a white cast. Other than that I really enjoy it.

Cetaphil Sunscreen Stick is a must-have for lifeguards! I've used it for over 15 years on the beach—it protects against harsh sun, absorbs fast, and never feels greasy. Reliable and effective every time!

Love this!!! Zero white cast at all and blends in make up. Lightweight & matte-finish: Quickly absorbs into the skin without greasiness, suitable for wearing under makeup or alone. Non-irritating: Fragrance- and paraben-free, well-tolerated even by eczema-prone skin; praised for being non-comedogenic
protects my skin without leaving a heavy cast on my face. Doesn't smell really bad and it absorbs into my skin really well and it's easy to throw in your bag for the beach.
this product has a heavy white cast and feels very thick on the skin. when i wore it i was asked what i had on my face because it looked like a face mask. i returned it.

This product is a sheer mineral sunscreen stick with spf 50 UV protection. With darker skin you can see the white caste you get associated with mineral sunscreen so it's not actually sheer. Rubbing it in helps but it still has the purple tint until you've had prolonged sun exposure and at that point it's time to reapply. This productive is convenient small packaging which makes it useful when you're on the go. Probably better dor lighter /fairer skin

Bought this for trip to Ireland for ease in packing and good brand. Did nothing for me. My nose peeled as if I'd gone out in the Texas sun without protection. And this in spite of wearing raingear and using umbrella about 50% of the time. So disappointing.

avis.titre: Best sunscreen that is mineral and does s good job
avis.texte: It has no scent.The packaging was very great.The texture is very smooth.It really does a good protecting your skin. Asorbds into skin well. Love this product a lot.Tip for black girlys:after u put this on rub into skin until the whiteness is gone doesn't take long for it to go.

The first red flag was the unclean finish when I first opened it. The second red flag was how white the stick was. The third and final straw was how white it was on my face, leaving streaks and a mess. I chose sun stick for the convenience of reapplication, especially outside where I may not have the resources to clean my hands before reapplication. So, having to use my hand to try to blend those white streaks was an inconvenience.

avis.titre: It's the perfect partner for the Summer
avis.texte: I'm a lifeguard and I spend the whole day out in the sun, so having a good sunscreen is non-negotiable for me. I started using the Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50 and honestly, it's become one of my go-to products. First off, the packaging caught my eye—it's super compact, easy to carry, and perfect for on-the-go reapplication. I just throw it in my pocket or bag and use it throughout the day without any mess. What really made me trust it more is the ingredient list. It's a 100% mineral formula with zinc oxide and titanium dioxide, which is great because it doesn't irritate my skin. I have sensitive skin, and this has never caused breakouts or redness. Plus, it's Fra-free, paraben-free, and hypoallergenic, which is a huge bonus for me. It does leave a bit of a white cast when you first apply it, but it blends out quickly and ends up looking natural. I mainly use it on my face, nose, and lips. I wouldn't use it on large areas like arms or legs—it's a small stick and would run out fast—but for face touch-ups during my shift, it works perfectly. If you're in the sun all day like me and need something practical, gentle, and effective, I definitely recommend giving this a try. I'd repurchase it for sure!
Not ideal for medium skin or darker it leaves a bit of white cast. But does not irritate skin and is not too oily
It's good but there are better options. It leaves the skin looking so white and it is tiny.
Not great for oily skin. But love the size and take it everywhere with me in my purse and at work.

avis.titre: Saves your skin, but leaves a white cast
avis.texte: I hate the white cast this leaves on my face! And I don't even have a darker skin tone so I don't know how this works for ANYBODY. I do appreciate how easy it is to apply though thanks to the packaging.

I've only used this product a couple times so far, but so far so good! I was looking for something reef-safe and hopefully non-greasy, and this appears to be it. Coming from using Sun Bum face sunscreen, this product isn't as good but it's good for the criteria I'm wanting to meet. There is a tiny bit of a whitecast if you know to look for it, but overall it's extremely smooth and easy to put on, doesn't seem to irritate my acne, and hasn't left my face looking greasy.

I'm not sure what I expected a half oz to look like, but this is barely bigger than a chapstick. I like this brand and it'll be a great travel stick to bring places, but just know before you buy this for almost $10.... It's basically a mini/travel size.

avis.titre: Travel friendly, easy to apply, and effective!
avis.texte: This is the easiest to apply mineral sunscreen I have ever used. It travels very well since you can take it in your carry-on baggage without affecting your liquid limitations for flying. It doesn't make a mess in your beach bag or purse. It does not have a strong fragrance at all. I used it for a week in sunny Mexico and did not get a sunburn!

Absolutely love this product and always keep it in my bag! Super light on my skin and absorbs so easily! Great every day sun protection with SPF 50. Also smells so good in my opinion! Plus it's an amazing value because one stick easily lasts 3-4 months!
I love how easy this is to travel with. Super easy for touch ups through out the day. It blends great and doesn't leave a white cast. Just like all cetaphil as product it is unscented
Love how they can fit in spaces throw it in your purse or on the go it is a wonderful product slides on smooth and it doesn't leave much residue, but it keeps my face from getting sunburnt. Love it.￼

It is a lightweight sunscreen that is highly water resistant and suitable for all skin, making it ideal for everyday protection. Non-comedogenic, fragrance-free, and paraben free.It does leave some white cast.But it's really good.

I wasn't sure what to expect since I first saw it at my grocery store but I'm pleasantly surprise. The Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen stick is the perfect size to take it on the go and carry with you for maximum sun protection. I like how it doesn't leave a white cast and it has no scent that will irritate my skin

picked this up on a whim since it was on sale at my drugstore. I've never use the Sun stick before but have always wanted to try it. This is a mineral sunscreen with 6% titanium dioxide and 4.7% zinc oxide. It does have a very, very slight white tint when you first put it on, but it easily rubs in. I would say the finish after you rub it in is a satin finish. It's definitely not greasy, but I wouldn't quite say it's Matte. I had a bad allergic reaction to something so I switched to all gentle skin care and minimal mineral sunscreens and this hasn't broken me out or caused any reaction while my skin is healing. The stick is a nice way to reapply while you're out and about or at the beach, but I haven't tried it over make up. I think it definitely would powder heavy foundation so I wouldn't use it for that. it has no smell and once I put it on, I actually kind of forget about it. It doesn't seem to get greasy through the day. But since my skin is healing, it has been flaky and dry and it definitely doesn't leave grease or hydrate, particularly as the flakes are still visible when I use this sunscreen versus a lotion type. But now that my skin is a bit more healed, the sunscreen looks great. for the price good buy! ￼￼

I live thats is so easy in the go, it doesn't leave any white residue is so practical and with nice packaging, i live it, sunscreen is something i wear everyday and cetaphil just makes it easier, no scent!
i love it because it's so convenient to carry and apply on your face quickly. i have used it for summer camp, long hot trips outside, etc and have been perfectly protected

This is such a nice sunscreen to apply! You can wear it alone or with makeup, with little to no white cast. The easy stick application makes it so easy to reapply sunscreen (something I know we all hate, myself included). It doesn't make you feel overly oily nor does it cause oil to build up throughout the day.
This sunscreen is the best sunscreen I have ever used. When looking for sunscreen you check for no white cast but this sunscreen??? zero white cast and it also doesn't feel think on the skin!!!
Got it out of the wrapping. Now, how do I open it to access the stick?

This sunscreen has quickly become a new favorite! it's so easy to apply and doesn't leave a white cast like mineral sunscreens tend to do. It's very affordable and performs just as well, if not better than higher priced options. It's spf 50, and water resistant for 80minutes.. longer than others I've seen.
This is a decent sunscreen stick. It's affordable but it does leave a little white cast. It doesn't blend in that easily but if you use it on your body it would probably work better

The cheapest sunscreen stick that I could find that's mineral. I use mineral because it's safer for the environment. It leaves a white cast that you have to rub in. I'm tan so you can see it well but if you have fair skin you shouldn't be able to see it. Like the price and the product.

The product itself is good and so is the price point, but my main problem is that it leaves a white cast. I dont think many sunscreen sticks dont leave a white cast so its fine, but the stick is easy to use and the spf is high!

I love this stick. The formula is a nice consistency. It's very quick to apply. I notice my husband actually using it. The best part is you don't have to get your hands dirty. It does need a little blending most of the time, but I've used the back of my hand to rub it in and that works while keeping my hands from getting greasy. I feel like this is a product that will actually get reapplied if we were out in the sun for a long time as well.

Works. Like. A. Gem. literally worth every penny, I LOVE IT! It works great with my face, and it barely is noticeable and that's one of the main things I love about this sunscreen stick! I recommend it, it works perfectly.
I like the compact sunscreen you can carry in your purse. It has a dry touch, does not leave the skin oily, easy to apply, very good

Best of the 3 mineral sunscreens I tried. It does goes on with slightly white cast but rubs in. It doesn't leave a white cast off on clothing. And it's fragrance free. I'd love to see offered in a higher SPF and in larger quantity. 0.5 oz. goes very quickly.

I bought this product and had high hopes for it because I love Cetaphil/have sensitive, acne-prone skin, but this product is just not good. I did a patch test on my skin for three days before applying it all over my face, and I have to say, this did NOT make me break out which is great! But as soon as I applied the sunscreen to my whole face, I quickly realized there was a terrible white cast all over. I decided to blend it in with my fingers which helped a little, but the sunscreen still felt so thick and sticky. I kept it on though because I knew it wouldn't make me break out and I needed reapplication of sunscreen. So far, I wasn't loving the product, but I didn't hate it. I liked how easy it was to use and how small it was for travel. However, when I went home to wash the sunscreen off, I was disappointed. I first used Cetaphil face wash to try and wash it off, but the sticky white sunscreen was not budging. It was just smudging all over my face the more I washed. I didn't want to scrub my face too hard so I continued to put more and more water on my face but this didn't help. I ended up having to use my makeup remover to remove all the sunscreen off of my face and even then, I had to wash my face a couple of times to ensure that all the stickiness came off. Extremely disappointed because I would love to have a product that I can swipe on my face for reapplication without using my fingers (for when I don't have access to a sink to wash my hands with).

I love this sun stick a lot! It's great for the price point, and is mineral which is a plus. Two problems are: need to be rubbed in because of white cast (goes away once rubbed into skin)c and makeup does transfer. (I don't wear makeup so it works for me)
This is a very creamy formula in spite of it being a bar. Not greasy (I have dry skin) and very comfortable. Not scented which I love. I totally recommend it! Very convenient for when on the go
While there cleanser burns my face I really like this product instead. It is great for re-application as a second layer for sunscreen and goes matte after a few seconds of application.

I bought this on a whim to keep in my beach bag for reapplication on my trip to Mexico, and it was perfect! I was worry about it being greasy, but that was never an issue. I got a nasty sunburn on my back, but the typical rudolph nose I end with on a vacation never happened!
This sunscreen is incredibly easy to put on, carry and share with others! Usually sunscreens break me out but this one doesn't. Good to apply under makeup too!

I love this sunscreen for my face, I use it everyday! Super easy to apply, and I love that it's SPF 50. It's small enough to fit into my purse but seems to have a good amount of product! This is also water resistant for up to 80 minutes!
Sunscreen should be worn every day not just for the suns rays but also the constant blue light we are experiencing. This is a former esthetician approved spf.

It's my first time using a sunscreen stick. I was impressed by the formula. I have very sensitive skin but it did not break my out or leave my skin looking red. I also have oily skin and this formula did not make my skin look more oily which is great. Usually sunscreens leave my skin oily. My only complaint is that the application wasn't the best. It was hard to apply, it didn't apply very smooth and left white marks.

This handy little stick is super helpful to keep in my purse and throw on when I'm spending more time outside than planned. I wish the shape was more circular than oval because it feels narrow when applying but for the size that's fine. I wouldn't rely on this stick for full coverage, but it's great for little spot touch ups on the go!

avis.titre: good for on the go, but not for daily use
avis.texte: I think this would be a great product for kids or even on the go, just to be able to throw it in your purse or pocket. However, it's not really meant for daily use. The consistency is similar to deodorant stick and it definitely has a chalky and white cast left on the face. I may end up using it this summer but I don't have much use of it now.
I'm a cetaphil fan and have used their products for years! This sunscreen doesn't feel greasy and I love that you can fit it in your pocket for on the go applications
Overall this is a great product. The packaging is very cute & clean looking. Would purchase in the near future. I wish there was a little more product in the tube. Would recommend to a friend

I've really been enjoying this sunscreen! I love that it's in a stick form because it makes me so easy and convenient to apply. SPF is so important in your skincare routine! Pro tip-spf should be the last step in your routine. I love that it's SPF 50 for extra protection. I just glide this across from my face to apply, and it's so easy and convenient. One con is that it might not be the most hygienic, but to be honest, it doesn't bother me because I only apply it on a clean face. It's not greasy at all, but is also not drying. Also, there is no fragrance, so it's perfect for sensitive skin. It's also affordable and available at the drugstore. I recommended this product if you're looking for an SPF for the face!

As a mom, I'm known to carry a plethora of small things everywhere/anywhere I can: in my bag, my car, my pockets, and a couple times, in my sock. (We do what we gotta.) So, count me thrilled that this guy fits in every carrying spot I can find. AND it's useful, isn't greasy, stays put on the skin and doesn't clog pores. Great for hard to get to spots on big and little faces. I'll certainly be picking a few others up to keep in multiple places.
Loved it! Very easy to use! Made it extremely easy to apply to my face and didn't leave my skin feeling oily or caked up with sunscreen.

I absolutely love love love this product! I've mainly been using it on my face because it's winter and I'm covered all over anyway except for my face. I've noticed slight fading of my sun spots. Will definitely keep on using.

I really liked using this sunscreen product. Being in a stick form it makes it easy to apply as well as easy to throw in a bag to take on the go. It had a great texture on my skin and looks great under makeup!

avis.titre: easy to re-apply during the day
avis.texte: I'm a sunscreen enthusiast. I tried many many facial sunscreens. I especially like this one because of its easy application. Through the day, usually is not the easiest to touch up your face. But with this one, I just swipe it in and blend it in with my fingertips. Also, I put it close to my eyes and it doesn't sting like some of the others.

avis.titre: perfect packaging for on the go skin care
avis.texte: Love the packaging! Perfect for travel or physical activity! the only reason it gets four stars and not five is because there is a white caste that's fairly noticeable as it is a mineral sunscreen. I have a fair skin tone so it doesn't bother me but I could see it being worse on anyone without decently fair skin. It won't be my daily sunscreen but will definitely be buying again.

I haven't got to put this product into action yet because of winter and I don't use stick spf then. I put it in with my fishing gear so I would be ready come warmer weather. I like the convenience of having a small stick that's easy to travel with.
It felt a little powdery going on but it evened out after a minute. It was nice that it was in stock form, I do prefer that over a liquid

I tried this suncreen under my makeup today. pros: lightweight, doesn't feel like it will clog pores. portable. has a white cast when applied, but goes away when rubbed in. cons: hard to apply. I'd prefer this is a lotion format. the stick was a little hard. white cast- I'm not sure if it would show up in photos once it's rubbed in, but it would be impossible to reapply over makeup. since it's white when you first apply it, you'd have to rub it over makeup.

avis.titre: Easy to use, portable, no white residue
avis.texte: I haven't used many stick sunscreen products, but was really pleased with the Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50! The stick can be twirled up like most deodorant products, so that made it easy to slide against my skin. I tried putting the stick on my fingers and the applying to my face, but found just putting the stick against my face worked well too. It didn't seem to stick or pull against my skin, so it slid on nice and then I just used my fingers to spread it around a little more. I don't feel like it left much of a white tint to my skin, and didn't leave my face feeling as shiny as other sunscreen products. The ingredients were non-irritating, and I didn't notice any more acne or breakouts after using this product. I will use this product when I'm expecting longer sun exposure, but not as my everyday facial sunscreen. Pro tip: I love that this product is not a liquid, so will be awesome to bring in a carry-on when I can finally travel safely again!
This sunscreen makes applying on children SO easy. We have taken this stick with us everywhere- super easy, doesn't make a mess, and small! Will be purchasing multiples for the summer!

I love this product! I am a teacher and it allows me to keep my face protected at recess! It fits perfectly in my bag and I can apply it easily, no mess! It is affordable and easy to find online and in store. Highly recommend!

I was happy to receive this Sheer Mineral Sunscreen stick to test, as it is super easy to apply and carry in the bag. This is super light on my skin and leaves no greasy, great for daily use, even before makeup. I loved. Don't forget: Sunscreen is the most important step in skincare!

great sunscreen! this sunscreen is awesome! goes on so smooth and doesn't clump at all. I really liked how it is also sheer too. some sunscreens are white and you can totally tell you're wearing sunscreen.

I overall really like this sunscreen! I don't prefer sunscreen in a stick form, but it is still easy to use and goes on smoothly. Although it is advertised to not have a white cast, I do notice that I need to rub it in a little bit to apply it all over my face and to get rid of the slight white cast. It's not very greasy when first applied, which is great for my very oily skin, but I do still get oily throughout the day. It also has SPF 50, which is great for protecting my skin! Overall, I'm really pleased with this product and may try the other sunscreens from this line!

I'm really happy I was able to test out this sunscreen, I was needing a new one for my face! This sunscreen applies dry, and it breaks off a little bit, which reminds me of chalk, and is a little inconsistent leaving white chunks on my face. I personally prefer a liquid sunscreen because I like to feel like I am evenly protecting my face. It's hard to tell with this one.

It is a good product will last what it says about 90 minutes. What I did not like at all is that it is white, and for me was hard to get it to clear on the skin. It is not sticky but is little heavy. I wouldn't put make up on top of it. Is it approved by the eczema foundation which is good. I would use this product in arms, hands, and ear lobes. On the face I also would buy if not wearing make up and going to the beach or for exposure to the sun.

I am a daily SPF user because it's the most important things you can do to protect your skin. I'm always looking for a non oily product that I can use under makeup and this works great. I tested it out on day where I would be outside for 4+ hours and my skin was perfectly protected. This product is affordable and effective. I love the formula and that it doesn't have a strong sunscreen scent.
Wow this is so smooth on the skin and makes it easy to spread. The best part is that it doesn't feel oily! This is so convenient to take around too. I just love it!

I was excited to try this product but nervous because I have never try to stick sunscreen before. I love it! It's not sticky or slimy, it glides onto the skin, and leaves 0 residue! I am also allergic to chemical sunscreens, so I'm glad that this is mineral one. ￼￼

This is so convenient for throwing in your pocket or purse. I have super pale skin so I'm always using sun screen and this worked great. My only negative was it's a little thick and hard to apply. Once you use it a couple times though super easy and great . Would definitely recommend!
Sun screen is not just for the summer and I think people forget that. I know I do. I wear this under my makeup daily and makes it easier for me not to forget to use it.

avis.titre: loving on this mini stick screen
avis.texte: If you're in the market for a new facial sunscreen, check out this one from cetaphil. Easy, mess free application, goes on smooth, you can wear it under makeup and it doesn't not make it look Cakey or greasy (I have combination skin). And best of all it's perfect for on the go. ￼￼￼

when it comes to stuff going on my face, I am very very picky! I didn't mind the Cetaphil mineral sunblock as much as I thought I would! it definitely didn't go on thick or pasty, no bad smell, and it didn't make my skin look greasy.
I like the idea of a stick sunblock! It's easy to apply, not greasy and lasts all day! I would love to use this during the summer when I'm outside all day! Perfect for the beach or a pool day!

I love how this product contains Ingredients that are safe for sensitive skin. Love using anything that this brand makes. I would definitely recommend it to anyone. Sunscreen should be a part of our daily routine!

I use SPF daily especially in winter time rays of sun is way stronger at that time of the year . I was first time trying Cetaphil sunscreen and from application i notice dry formula and it gave white cast to my skin which i didn't like . Also later it appears on a skin oily i don't know why. Overall i wouldn't recommend this product bot for me .

I really like this product￼ It's smooth on the skin￼ And leaves no Pigment￼ on the￼ skin. It is odorless and does not leave you asked oily as other sunscreen. It is quite affordable and you can take anywhere since it is the mini version.￼￼￼

I've been looking for a new product to use on my face during the summer so this was perfect. It's unscented and the perfect size for travel to the pool. My only issue is with influenster. Y'all picked the worst time to send this in the middle of winter when I couldn't really use or test it out.
This product is great it has sufficient coverage but is not too heavy and it does not go on streaky so you can wear it every day

I love how great this product is for sensitive skin! My skin is extremely sensitive and sunscreens sometimes over-irritate. I also love how easy and portable it is. The size is perfect for on the go easy application!

avis.titre: New addition to my skincare routine!
avis.texte: This is such a great addition to my skins are routine. I can't wait to try it out in the hot summer months as well! it doesn't feel greasy and it doesn't bother my face and eyes like many other sunscreens do. I would recommend this to everyone!

avis.titre: Great for touch ups on the go!
avis.texte: I don't generally love this type of application. However, this is great for reapplication on the go or at the beach especially with small children. It is lightweight and goes on easily for fast worry free application. It is not ideal for a large area but it is great for the face and ears.
I plan on bringing it on vacation as soon as I can travel. I love cetaphil products and I am excited to use this one. I like that it's stick form and skin safe
Very nice on the skin. It does protect my face! Easy to apply! And it is small so it fits perfectly in my purse! Definitely recommend.
Love this stuff. Used it on a trip to Mexico and I was really impressed by the coverage it gave me. I usually burn but this was really good!

So far this product is one I would consider buying! I like the ingredients and the way that it feels on my skin. I have sensitive skin on my face so I am always skeptical to try new facial products. It never left my skin irritated or burning, so it seems it would be great for those with sensitive skin. My only complaint about this product is the ease of application. The stick seems pretty hard and not much product comes off when trying to apply to my skin. Im not sure if it is something I'm doing wrong or if maybe the stick doesn't work as well when it's cold? I would like to try the product out when it's warmer and the sun is more intense to see if it's effective and if application runs more smoothly.

I loved using this amazing sunscreen that I received! I was smooth and very lightweight on the skin. It didn't leave any flashback which I was worried about. it exceeded all of my expectations and I would definitely recommend this to everyone. especially those with sensitive skin like myself!

I've been looking for a good sunscreen, and let me tell you.. This sunscreen is amazing for everyday use, I love that it came in a stick form it allows for easy application. It's also came in a small size so it's great to throw in your bag when you're on the go!

This Cetaphil stick sunscreen has been great so far; it is not messy at all and has a smooth application. It has a very small white cast, but if you rub it in, it completely vanishes. I love that it has an SPF of 50 and also how travel friendly it is. I can bring it anywhere I go and reapply sunscreen through out the day. I would definitely recommend it!
I was pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen stick. It's SO easy to apply, doesn't get your hands greasey, and doesn't leave a white appearance on your face. Approved!

This has a very nice thin sheer feeling to it and I love it for my oily prone skin. It has not made me breakout which I'm very satisfied with. It does have a small bit of white cast but you can blend it out with your fingers, flat makeup brush or a beauty blender. Feels great underneath my makeup as well and stays on.

love cetaphil! I use a ton of their products but i've never tried this so i was super excited to try this. It works super good and glides on smoothly. only down side is i feel like it caused my make up to separate.
Not sticky, easy to apply, and does the job! I have always loved cetaphil, and this product did not disappoint!

Although the application wasn't anything difficult, I didn't much care for it being a stick. I much rather would prefer the liquid. However, I was still impressed with this product, just would want a different version.

I love the convenience of this product- it goes on easily, didn't budge through my outdoor run, and left a nice glory finish. However, it left a slight white cast on my skin, and I'm quite fair. May not work for all skin tones.

This sunscreen has quickly become a new favorite! it's so easy to apply and doesn't leave a white cast like mineral sunscreens tend to do. It's very affordable and performs just as well, if not better than higher priced options. It's spf 50, and water resistant for 80minutes.. longer than others I've seen. Plus it's safe for sensitive skin and microbiome gentle. I could go on and on about the goodness in this sunscreen, or you could just pick it up and see for yourself, you won't regret it.

I didn't necessarily have high hopes for a sunscreen. But, I was WRONG. This stick glides on completely sheer, no white. This also does NOT have a signature sunscreen smell! It's light, doesn't feel greasy and heavy, and works great on babies/kids when you want to be quick but not get gross sunscreen on you hands, to apply to them! (do not use an aerosol spray sunscreen on your babies) I am very pleasantly surprised with this product.

I love cetaphil products in general. Easy on the skin. This is a small convenient stick that is easy to pack in a bag or purse and pull out to reapply. Not greasy which always a plus. Like the high spf.
This is very light weight and easy to apply! This is the perfect face sunscreen. I can't wait to use this as my go to product for the summer.

avis.titre: this is my new go- to!
avis.texte: I started using the cetaphil sheer stick this week, and I'm so impressed with it. I've tried so many different brands that worked, but they were pricey, but left me feely greasy or heavy. This doesn't do that! I have dry/combo skin. Usually by the end of the day I'm oily/splotchy in my t-zone. Not with cetaphil sheer! I'm happy to report that it feels amazing, and it isn't detectible on my skin, and has no scent like my other "higher end" brands. They worked but always left me feeling greasy, heavy, had a scent,etc. Cetaphil sheer stick doesn't do that. It worth trying beautiful people! I can't wait to try some others from this this new line. The stick is easy to glide across your hands and chest as well. Don't forget to use your spf, and don't skin your hands! We show our age all over but you can definitely tell your age in your hand, so don't leave those out. We have to wash our hands a lot these days, so pulling out my stick and reapplying is very convenient!

This is perfectly fit to my need as I go out all day long and I can carry this with me and reapply any second. The wax-feel stick help spread the sunscreen evenly on my face or where I wanted to apply without mess on my finger. This saves me a lot of time and efforts, plus the sunscreen itself.

I do not love this product but I also don't hate it. The texture is a little bit odd and almost feels a bit greasy. I am happy there is no smell and it is sheer like it is advertised. I did not get to necessarily "test" this product since it is winter and we don't see much sun this time of year where I live!

When I was selected to review mineral sunscreen I was so excited because mineral sunscreen is the best! Protects your skin without actual absorbing into it, makes me feel like it's better for my skin! Non greasy and easy to apply! Love it

I have used this already a few times I enjoy that it is not heavily scented. Being in stick form is easier for applying for myself. Size is great for transportation. I like it, but I would have to say it is a little thick almost like a bar of soap being rubbed on skin. Not the smoothest, other than I do enjoy it. Received for testing purposes.
It's not my first time using this product product that we always use when we go to the beach or the park an awesome product to use very affordable not expensive I would recommend it

I haven't used this for it's intended purposes, because I live in the NE and it's been gloomy and cold, plus I don't leave due to the pandemic, but I used it to see what it was like. It's not heavy or oily which I love. And I love that it's a high SPF, so I feel good about using it on my kid!
Was pleasantly surprised with the sheer coverage, my only con and reason for rating is the stick packaging. I'd rather have an SPF that can be warmed in the hands and then applied to the skin.
